# Contributing

Thanks for your interest in contributing to this project. A few guidelines to get started:

- Open an issue to discuss larger changes before implementing them.
- Fork the repository and create a feature branch for your work.
- Write clear commit messages and keep changes focused.
- Run `cargo test --workspace` and ensure existing tests pass.
- Add tests or examples for new functionality when possible.

When your change is ready, open a pull request describing what you changed and why.
